subject.title: refactor(config): add canonical group-policy scope-tree resolver and migrate the first six channels

question: Should ScopeTree and its low-level resolver/building functions become a supported public Plugin SDK contract for external channel plugins?
rationale: The migration needs a shared seam, but exporting the low-level tree model commits OpenClaw to its precedence and data-shape semantics beyond the six bundled adapters; tests cannot decide that long-term API boundary.

options.title: Approve the public ScopeTree API
options.body: Treat these exports as the durable channel-policy contract, add concise contract documentation, and require compatibility-preserving evolution.

options.title: Expose a narrower adapter API
options.body: Keep ScopeTree internal and publish only higher-level channel-policy builder or resolver callbacks that leave representation and precedence details changeable.

options.title: Pause the normalization
options.body: Do not merge the consolidated migration until maintainers settle the permanent plugin-facing policy abstraction.

recommendation.title: Approve the public ScopeTree API
recommendation.body: Treat these exports as the durable channel-policy contract, add concise contract documentation, and require compatibility-preserving evolution.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the normalization design and consolidated migration and is the strongest available signal for the intended SDK boundary.
